{{Quote|Tasked with uncovering disloyalty and inefficiency, this branch reports all infractions directly to the central ISB hub on Coruscant.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] describes the Surveillance branch, ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Surveillance''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. The largest branch within the ISB, Surveillance accounted for almost thirty-five percent of the Bureau's manpower. The personnel from Surveillance were generally drawn from [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|Sub-Adult Groups]], [[CompForce Observer]]s, veteran officials from the [[Sector Monitor/Legends|Sector Monitors]], or personnel from [[Sector Development]]. Surveillance's mandate was to uncover those individuals or activities that would either pose a threat to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and its operations, or assist its enemies, such as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. If sufficient evidence in either case was found, the matter was turned over to [[Investigations/Legends|Investigations]] for further action. Surveillance was also employed as a deterrent; the citizen's fear of the branch and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] stopped many from supporting the Rebellion.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
